cues.en: And that's why these are no longer ones.
cues.zh: 所以現在不再全是 1。

cues.en: To be honest, I wish there were an easier and more universal way to save models from any library, but once you get used to it, it's not so bad.
cues.zh: 坦白說，我希望任何函式庫都有更簡單、統一的模型儲存方法，但習慣之後，其實也沒那麼糟。
